harbor_closed.speaker: kit
harbor_closed.text: They closed the whole harbor. No ships in, no ships out, until we pay for the tea. And town meetings are basically banned.

congress.speaker: delegate
congress.text: Twelve colonies are here. We will stop trading with Britain, and we will send a petition to the King. If he does not listen, we meet again in May.

congress.speaker: sivart
congress.text: They're still asking the King nicely?

congress.speaker: senoj
congress.text: Most of them still wanted to stay British. Watch how fast that changes.
